name: The Night-Market Auntie
ability: Regular's Discount — the first vendor you court in EACH of your first two regions costs 1 fewer ingredient (she vouches for you).
flaw: Set in her ways — no HSR (North<->South); she routes the ring the long way, loving the scenic local rail and every backstreet.
effect: 阿姨 · Warm, sharp-eyed market veteran who knows every backstreet. Ability: first court in each of your first two regions costs 1 fewer ingredient. Flaw: no HSR — travel the ring the long way.
art_note: A cheerful apron-clad auntie waving you over to her stall — dignified

name: The Eager Rookie
ability: First-Timer's Luck — when an Event fires in your region, draw 2 tiles and resolve 1 (you pick).
flaw: Bites off too much — your Larder caps at 6 (not 7).
effect: 菜鳥 · Bright-eyed first-season agent, all enthusiasm. Ability: on an Event in your region, draw 2 tiles resolve 1. Flaw: Larder cap 6. [TABLE-WATCH: kit rides on event luck the sim abstracts — validate at FTUE.]
art_note: A wide-eyed newcomer with a fresh lanyard and an overstuffed bag

name: The Retired Conductor
ability: Off-Peak Pass — your Travel action arrives with 2 ingredients instead of 1 (a proud, expert retired railwayman).
flaw: Timetable-bound — if you took the Stock Up action on your PREVIOUS turn, your Stock Up this turn yields only 1 (instead of 2). A run of Stock Ups gives 2, 1, 1…; any other action between resets it (the timetable moves on — he can't linger at one stall).
effect: 車長 · Proud, warm retired railwayman who rode every line. Ability: Travel arrives with 2 ingredients. Flaw: back-to-back Stock Ups yield only 1 (a run gives 2,1,1…; any other action resets it).
art_note: A dignified older conductor in a crisp cap

name: The Influencer
ability: Going Viral — your Promote takes +1 Buzz (3 instead of 2).
flaw: Chasing clout — you go LAST in turn order and start 2 resources behind.
effect: 網紅 · Genuinely loves the food and shares it — an affectionate self-aware wink, never a vapid punchline. Ability: Promote takes 3 Buzz. Flaw: go last, start 2 resources behind.
art_note: A stylish food blogger framing a bowl for the perfect shot

name: The Grizzled Gourmand
ability: Connoisseur — once per turn, treat 1 pantry as any 1 specialty when courting (courting flexibility).
flaw: Too jaded — you cannot gain Buzz from boon Events (you still get their other effects).
effect: 老饕 · Grumpy, discerning veteran eater — universal archetype. Ability: once/turn treat 1 pantry as any specialty when courting. Flaw: no Buzz from boon Events. [TABLE-WATCH: pantry-wild is invisible to greedy bots — validate at FTUE.]
